description: Six-panel TEM figure on CR20% + annealed low-density steel strips, pairing bright-field (BF) images (with selected-area diffraction, SAED, insets) with dark-field (DF) images formed from the (001) κ-carbide superlattice reflection. (a) BF of γ-austenite in the 0Cr strip, 100 nm scale bar, dense tangled dislocations and slip bands; inset SAED along [110] with the 001 superlattice spot circled in red. (b) the matching (001) DF, annotated "(001)", 100 nm bar, with yellow arrows and the label "κ" marking bright κ-carbide particles decorating the dislocation tangles. (c) BF of γ-austenite in the 3Cr strip, 500 nm bar, containing a yellow boxed region, with a [110] SAED inset and 001 circled; (d) its (001) DF, 100 nm bar, again arrowed "κ" precipitates. (e) BF of the 6Cr strip, 500 nm bar, [110] SAED inset with 001 circled. (f) its (001) DF, 500 nm bar, essentially featureless uniform grey. The figure demonstrates that post-cold-rolling annealing precipitates κ-carbides in the 0Cr and 3Cr strips, whereas in the 6Cr strip the κ-carbides are too small to image, while high-density slip bands persist in all three strips.

subfigures.description: BF TEM image of γ-austenite in the CR20% + annealed 0Cr steel strip, 100 nm scale bar, showing dense tangled dislocations and slip bands; inset SAED pattern along [110] zone axis with the 001 superlattice reflection circled in red.

Dark-field TEM image from the (001) superlattice reflection (annotated '(001)') of the 0Cr strip, 100 nm scale bar, showing bright dot-like κ-carbide particles marked by yellow arrows and the label 'κ', located at dislocation tangles.

BF TEM image of γ-austenite in the 3Cr steel strip, 500 nm scale bar, showing deformation bands/subgrain structure with a yellow rectangular box marking a region; inset SAED along [110] with the 001 reflection circled in red.
Dark-field image from the (001) reflection (annotated '(001)') of the 3Cr strip, 100 nm scale bar, with yellow arrows and 'κ' marking small bright κ-carbide precipitates.
BF TEM image of γ-austenite in the 6Cr steel strip, 500 nm scale bar, showing dislocation/slip-band structure; inset SAED pattern along [110] zone axis with the 001 reflection circled in red.
Dark-field image from the (001) reflection (annotated '(001)') of the 6Cr strip, 500 nm scale bar, essentially featureless and uniformly grey with no resolvable κ-carbide particles.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a BF TEM micrograph with a 100 nm scale bar showing dense tangled dislocations and slip bands in the CR20% + annealed 0Cr steel strip.
The inset SAED pattern in (a) is indexed along the [110] zone axis and the 001 superlattice reflection is highlighted with a red circle; the remaining diffraction spots carry no index labels.

Panel (b) is annotated '(001)' and has a 100 nm scale bar; bright dot-like particles labelled 'κ' with yellow arrows sit on dislocation tangles, i.e. κ-carbides are imaged by dark field in the 0Cr strip.
Panel (c) is a BF image with a 500 nm scale bar in which a yellow rectangle outlines a local region of the deformation structure of the 3Cr steel strip.

Panel (f), the (001) dark-field image of the 6Cr steel strip, is uniformly grey and featureless with no visible bright κ-carbide particles, whereas the analogous panels (b) and (d) for 0Cr and 3Cr show discrete bright particles.

The caption states (a), (c) and (e) are BF images of γ-austenite and (b), (d), (f) are dark-field images from the (001) superlattice reflection of the κ-carbides for the 0Cr, 3Cr and 6Cr steel strips respectively.
The caption writes panel (f) as 'DE from (001)' (apparent typo for DF), while the panel itself is annotated '(001)' and shows a dark-field appearance.
The citing text states the SADPs were taken along the [110] and [100] zone axes, whereas only a [110] label is visible in the insets of the BF images.
The citing text states the dark-field images indicate κ-carbides are mainly precipitated at the dislocation entanglement in the CR20% + annealed 0Cr and 3Cr steel strips.
The citing text states that in the CR20% + annealed 6Cr steel strip the κ-carbides are too small to be observed in the dark-field image, consistent with the featureless panel (f).

The citing text states that annealing after cold rolling promotes κ-carbide precipitation but does not eliminate the dislocations and slip bands, which panel (a)/(c)/(e) BF images support by showing retained deformation structures.

unreadable_items: SAED inset: individual diffraction spot indices other than the circled 001 reflection and the [110] zone-axis label are not labelled/readable
caption mentions [100] zone-axis SADPs, but no [100] inset label is visible in any panel
content enclosed by the yellow rectangle in panel (c) is not shown at higher magnification anywhere in the figure
